main.description: Sign up for HappyProto in the open beta: accept the beta terms in force and join the customers space. Any signed-in caller while signup is open. A caller who is already a customer has the terms recorded and joins nothing. Safe to retry with the same idempotencyKey.

termsVersion.description: The terms the caller accepted, as getTerms reported them. Anything but the terms in force is refused (TermsOutdated).

textVersion.description: The version of the wording the caller was shown, chosen by the client.

text.description: The exact wording the caller accepted.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per signup and resends on every retry of it.

isCustomer.description: Always true: the caller is a customer now.

joined.description: Whether this call joined the caller to the customers space; false when they already were a member.

termsVersion.description: The beta terms in force, which the caller has now accepted.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: termsVersion, textVersion, text or idempotencyKey is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: SignupClosed
errors.description: Signup is not open: HappyProto is invite-only.

errors.name: SignupsPaused
errors.description: Too many accounts signed up in the last hour or day. Try again later.

errors.name: TermsRequired
errors.description: The wording or its version is blank.

errors.name: TermsOutdated
errors.description: termsVersion is not the terms in force: the client is showing old terms, and should read getTerms again.

errors.name: AccountSuspended
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: staff have suspended the account.

errors.name: PlanNotOffered
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: owners may not pick that plan themselves; it is available on request.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The customers space or the provisioner is unreachable or not configured, the standing signup invite is misconfigured, or the provisioner answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
